title: Aap Aye Bahaar Ayee
writer: Mohan Kumar, Ved Rahi, Ram Swarup
actors: Rajendra Kumar Tuli, Sadhana Shivdasani, Prem Chopra
plot: Rohit, Whiskey, and Kumar (Rajendra Kumar, Rajendra Nath, and Prem Chopra respectively) are childhood friends. While travelling to his estate in the company of Whiskey, Rohit meets with beautiful Neena (Sadhana), and falls in love...
